title: The Old Testament in the Book of Revelation
author: Steve Moyise
summary: Journal for the Study of the New Testament Supplement 115 (Sheffield Academic Press). Studies how Revelation absorbs and reshapes Old Testament texts, especially Ezekiel, through allusion rather than formal quotation.

title: Isaiah and Prophetic Traditions in the Book of Revelation: Visionary Antecedents and Their Development
author: Jan Fekkes III
summary: JSNT Supplement 93 (Sheffield Academic Press). Detailed study of Revelation's allusions to Isaiah and other prophets, sorting them by how confidently they can be identified.

title: The Use of Daniel in Jewish Apocalyptic Literature and in the Revelation of St. John
author: G. K. Beale
summary: University Press of America. Argues that Daniel, especially chapters 2 and 7, provides an interpretive framework for several major sections of Revelation.

title: The Gospel According to John
author: D. A. Carson
summary: Pillar New Testament Commentary (Eerdmans/IVP). Standard evangelical commentary on John, including the Lamb of God, Word, living water and 'I am' sayings.
